skill2: Activates when above 80% HP. (HP-threshold gate — no HP pool at scope lock; nobody takes damage, so the gate is permanently satisfied and modeled as an unconditional passive.)
burst: Recovers 16.16% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec. (HP amount unmodeled — emitted as 10 recovery events so on-recovery consumers fire; no HP pool exists in v1.)
Incoming healing ▲ 75.5% for 10 sec. (Healing-magnitude scaler — no HP pool is modeled, so it has no consumer; no StatKey exists for incoming-healing.)

caveats: ⚑ skill1 block 1 trigger phase: kit says "Activates every 20 sec" with no stated first-fire; modeled as interval sec:20 (first fire t=20s). If it actually fires at t=0 the 10s ATK window shifts a full cycle — pin from footage (buff-icon appearance vs the 3:00 anchor).

⚑ skill2 block 2 trigger identity: "attacking with Full Charge for 10 time(s)" modeled as chargeCounter count:10. Whether the counter is per-battle-cumulative-recurring (assumed) vs once-only is not stated in the prose.
⚑ burst CDR target set: "Affects all allies" on the 2.83s burst-CDR is taken literally (team-wide). If in-game it only reduces the owner's own burst cooldown the rotation effect is much smaller.

⚑ cadence tuple (chargeFrames 60, reloadFrames 141, ammo 6) comes from the datamine, which is unreliable for rate_of_fire/reloadFrames; the 10-full-charge threshold's real-time cadence rests on it directly.

⚑ skill1 block 2 "continuously" burst-CDR: modeled as a one-shot 20s reduction at battle start (oncePerBattle). If "continuously" instead means a permanent cooldown REDUCTION applied to every burst cycle (40s → 20s each time), the rotation impact is far larger. Highest-leverage unknown in this kit.

Burst damage (367.34%) targets "1 enemy unit with the highest final DEF" — single-target selection is trivial against the single scope-lock boss; the target-ranking clause carries no information here.
PARSER BASELINE — no ⚑ value below has been measured against a real fight.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Milk (Treasure) `milk` — SR/Water/Attacker/Burst I charge weapon (ammo 6, chargeFrames 60). Modeled: S1 a 20s-interval ATK ▲31.83%/10s on the 3 highest-final-ATK allies (target ranked byFinalAtk per the literal "highest final ATK" wording); S1 a battle-start self burst-CDR of 20s; S2 an always-on team Critical Damage ▲11.13% (the >80% HP gate is permanently satisfied at scope lock — the boss deals no damage); S2 a team burst-CDR of 2.83s every 10 full charges; burst a 367.34% single-target hit plus a 10-tick heal-over-time to all allies. Deliberately unmodeled: the healing MAGNITUDE (16.16% of attack damage) and Incoming Healing ▲75.5%, because v1 models no HP pool — the heal is still emitted as recovery EVENTS so heal-synergy consumers (on-recovery triggers) fire correctly, which is its only offensive channel. The two burst-CDR values and the interval first-fire phase are the load-bearing rotation unknowns; a Burst I unit's CDR feeds the full-burst chain directly, so a wrong reading here changes FB counts, not just magnitude.

flags.estimate: One-shot 20s reduction applied at battle start (so Milk's first burst is castable ~20s early against her 40s CD)
flags.reasoning: "Activates at the start of battle … Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼ 20 sec continuously" is genuinely ambiguous. Reading A (modeled): a single start-of-battle CDR — "continuously" describes the buff never expiring rather than re-firing. Reading B: a standing 50% cooldown reduction, so EVERY Milk burst cycle costs 20s instead of 40s. The two diverge enormously for a Burst I unit whose cooldown gates the whole chain opener: Reading B roughly doubles her availability across a 180s fight. The conservative reading is modeled because oncePerBattle cannot over-credit, whereas a recurring encoding compounds error every cycle. This is the single highest-leverage unknown in the kit.
flags.recipe: Run the graded fixture both ways (oncePerBattle:true vs false/recurring) and compare MEASURED full-burst COUNT against footage — a rotation change is judged by FB-count preservation, not by aggregate ratio. Independently: on a real recording, timestamp Milk's 1st and 2nd burst casts against the 3:00→2:59 anchor. A ~40s inter-burst gap confirms Reading A; ~20s confirms Reading B. The 2nd-cast timing discriminates cleanly and needs no damage read at all.

flags.estimate: First fire at t=20s (the engine's interval convention), then every 20s: windows ≈ 20–30s, 40–50s, 60–70s …
flags.reasoning: "Activates every 20 sec" states a period but no phase. The engine's `interval` trigger first-fires at t=sec by convention, but many battle-start kit lines fire at t=0 instead. With a 10s buff on a 20s period the skill has a 50% uptime, so the phase choice determines WHICH half of each 20s block is buffed — and whether the buff is live during the opening full-burst window, where it is worth the most. Off-by-one-cycle here is a real magnitude error on the 3 buffed allies, not a rounding artifact.
flags.recipe: Frame-read a recording for the ATK ▲ buff icon's first appearance on the affected allies, anchored to the exact 3:00→02:59 frame (game t0 — never the load screen). Icon at ~00:20 confirms t=sec; at ~00:00 confirms t=0. One recording answers it; no damage arithmetic required.

flags.estimate: 10 full charges ≈ one 6-round magazine + reload + 4 more charges; at chargeFrames 60 (1.0s) + release latency + reloadFrames 141 (~2.35s), roughly 15–20s per activation → ~9–12 activations across a 180s fight, i.e. ~25–34s of cumulative team burst-CDR
flags.reasoning: Two stacked uncertainties. (a) chargeFrames/reloadFrames are datamined and the ALWAYS-⚑ taxonomy marks the cadence tuple unreliable; the real per-charge cycle also includes the measured 22-frame release latency and any aim/re-target time not in the datamine. (b) The prose does not say whether the 10-charge counter is cumulative-and-recurring (assumed) or a once-per-battle threshold. Because the payload is burst-CDR on a Burst I unit, an error compounds into full-burst COUNT, which is the sim's measured-exact rotation invariant — so this is not a magnitude-only risk.
flags.recipe: Count Milk's full-charge shots between consecutive burst-CDR procs on a recording (the CD-reduction is visible as a burst-gauge/cooldown jump), and separately time her charge→fire→reload cycle from the ammo counter — the ammo counter measures shots/sec DIRECTLY, rather than inferring it downstream of FB counts. Then assert the resulting activation count in scripts/tests/units/milk.test.ts via a burstCast/buffApply event count, so the cadence is pinned by a committed fixture.

flags.estimate: Team-wide (all 5 allies receive the 2.83s CDR), per the literal "Affects all allies" header
flags.reasoning: The structural header says all allies, and the literal-word rule governs. But burst-CDR distributed team-wide is a substantially stronger rotation effect than a self-only CDR, and Burst-I kits sometimes word a self-cooldown line loosely. Modeled literally because the prose is the ground truth here; flagged because the rotation consequence is large enough that a misread changes FB counts.
flags.recipe: Same discriminator as the first flag: FB-count preservation on the graded comps, plus checking whether OTHER units' burst cooldowns visibly jump when the proc lands. Note the whole-picture check — this flag and the skill1 CDR flag interact; if both are over-modeled the rotation over-generates full bursts, and a rotation over-generation is usually a mis-sourced constant rather than a selection-rule error. Resolve them TOGETHER against one recording's full timeline, not independently, since compensating errors can make a wrong pair look right.

flags.estimate: Burst damage crits at Milk's sheet rate (crit:true), takes no core, no range bonus, and no +50% Full Burst major
flags.reasoning: The FB exemption is a verified project fact (burst-cast damage lands before Full Burst begins), so it is not itself in doubt. What is a convention rather than a measurement is crit-eligibility on the burst hit: the schema treats crit as opt-in per effect. Team-wide crit-damage from her own S2 (+11.13%) rides on this, so the crit flag is not cosmetic for a burst this size (367.34%).
flags.recipe: Read the burst popup colour on a recording — orange + crit icon confirms crit-eligible, plain white confirms not (per the popup-colour convention). n=1 is enough to confirm crit-CAPABILITY (a single orange popup proves the channel exists); establishing the RATE would need the sheet rate, which is already known. Do not infer this from damage magnitude — that is confounded by the unknown ATK.

flags.estimate: 10 recovery events at 1s intervals across the 10s window
flags.reasoning: "Recovers … as HP over 10 sec" is a heal-over-time, but the prose does not state the tick interval — 1s is the schema default and the game's usual HoT cadence. The tick COUNT is the only thing that matters offensively at scope lock: it sets how many times a teammate's on-recovery trigger (a real damage channel on heal-synergy kits) fires. A single-event encoding would under-credit such a teammate by 10×; a wrong interval mis-times the refreshes.
flags.recipe: Confirm by counting green heal popups in the 10s window after Milk's burst on any recording that includes her (green = heal, per the popup-colour convention). Independently, if any teammate with an on-recovery trigger is in the comp, that unit's proc count across the window is a second, damage-side read of the same quantity.
